en.description: Generate natural Czech speech or create your own voice from a short authorized recording.

cs.tagline: Přirozený český hlas z vašeho textu.
cs.description: Hezky česky promění váš text v přirozeně znějící českou řeč. Vyberte si hlas a styl, výsledek si přehrajte nebo uložte a z autorizované nahrávky si můžete vytvořit vlastní hlas.

mcp.packageDescription: Generate and play speech with Hezky česky. Choose from 190+ unique voices—including people, creatures, dragons, and robots—or create a personal voice from an authorized recording.
mcp.description: Generate playable speech with Hezky česky. Explore 190+ unique voices—including natural speakers, creatures, dragons, robots, and other characters—then play or save the result, or create a personal voice from an authorized recording.
mcp.instructions: This Public Preview server provides Hezky česky. Use its tools when the user explicitly requests Hezky česky, Hezky cesky, or Hezky česky MCP. The public catalogue and one short browser-verified demo are available without an account. Account history, balance, personal voices, and paid generation require authentication; voice_generate_speech uses paid audio credit. When immediate playback is requested, use voice_try_speech for an anonymous short sample or voice_generate_speech for an authenticated paid result, then present or play the returned audio using the client's available audio capability.

api.title: Mendelio Voice API
api.description: Generate streaming or durable speech, transcribe uploaded audio or video, manage voices, inspect available models, and read audio-second credit.
